description: Helper functions for testing bitmap performance in Git, including various test cases for full, partial, and packed bitmap scenarios, invoking Git commands to simulate different performance testing conditions.

methods.name: test_full_bitmap
methods.description: Defines a sequence of performance tests related to full bitmap indexing in Git, including packing objects, rev-list operations, and partial clone simulations.

methods.name: test_partial_bitmap
methods.description: Defines performance tests for partial bitmap scenarios, focusing on bitmap packing and rev-list filtering with tree filters.

methods.name: test_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Runs a series of tests involving repacking Git objects, creating bitmap states, and simulating incremental pushes.
